annotations.title: Compare terms and balloons for one car

description: Side-by-side payment, total interest, balloon and underwater stretch for 2 to 6 term and balloon combinations on the same car, price, down payment and APR (for example 120 vs 180 months, or 0% vs 30% balloon), using the exoticcar.loans calculator math.

apr.description: APR in percent from the borrower's own quote, e.g. 8.5. This server has no rate of its own.

finance_tax.description: Roll the sales tax into the loan (true, default) or pay it at signing (false).

model.description: Depreciation preset from https://exoticcar.loans/depreciation/ (annualized published figure). Default "all-vehicles" (iSeeCars all-vehicle benchmark). Ignored when value_change_pct is given.

balloon_pct.description: Balloon due with the last payment, as a percent of the price, 0 to 60. Default 0.

months.description: Term in months, 36 to 180 (the site offers 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, 96, 120, 144, 180).

price.description: Purchase price in US dollars, e.g. 250000.

sales_tax_pct.description: Sales tax rate in percent. Default 0.

value_change_pct.description: Your own expected change in the car's value per year, percent; negative = losing value (e.g. -5). Overrides model.

name: compare_exotic_car_loan_terms
title: Compare terms and balloons for one car
